claims.statement: Joe Goss won the heavyweight championship from Tom Allen by disgraceful methods; the paper says Allen had beaten his opponent to ribbons.
claims.excerpt: from Ton Allen of this city, who beat his opponent to ribbons.

fights.excerpt: from Ton Allen of this city, who beat his opponent to ribbons.
fights.notes: Heavyweight title fight, Goss over Allen, by the paper's account. Date not given in this article (hint said 1876, unverified here).

notes: Allen appears only in one line of a Sullivan/Corbett records article. Name printed as Ton Allen.
